Name: RED VALLEY REDEMPTION
Author: whtjdwo7852
Description:
[size=5][b]RED VALLEY REDEMPTION[/b][/size]
A firearms progression mod by JOEWRKS. Start with western revolvers and shotguns, work toward rifles and the C96, and earn the MP5 and M1 Garand through the Adventurer's Guild.

[b]Version 0.1.0 — single-player beta[/b]
Tested on Windows, Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.3.2, with keyboard and mouse. Multiplayer, split-screen and controllers are not supported. Other platforms, newer game versions and all mod combinations have not been validated. Automated tests and owner gameplay checks do not replace complete release testing; reward recovery, interruptions and save/load edge cases still need wider testing.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
10 firearms and 16 ammunition types. Directional pixel-art weapons, an aiming crosshair, custom firing and mechanical sounds, ammunition reserves, staged reloads, durability, cleaning and repair. The MP5 supports held automatic fire; other guns fire once per click.
Four rare craft/drop ammunition types add distinct effects: Silver for supernatural targets and fallen Mummies, Breaching shells for a destructive frontal blast, Explosive rifle rounds for a small impact explosion, and Ricochet 9mm for bouncing between targets.
English and Korean are included. No Content Patcher or Json Assets dependency.

[size=4][b]Install and play[/b][/size]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and back up your save.
2. Quit the game. Extract the ZIP into Mods so the path is Mods/RedValleyRedemption/manifest.json. Keep only one installed copy.
3. Start StardewModdingAPI. Buy an unlocked gun and matching ammunition at the Adventurer's Guild.
4. Hold ammo on your inventory cursor and right-click the gun to attach the reserve. Equip it and press R to load.

[b]Controls[/b]
Left-click: fire toward cursor; hold for MP5 automatic fire.
Hold right-click: aim, show crosshair, move more slowly.
R once: start a complete reload, including round-by-round guns.
Hold Shift+G for 1.5 seconds while stationary with gun oil: clean.
Clint's normal blacksmith service: repair.
Hover the gun: ammo, loaded count and condition.
New guns are empty. Attaching ammo alone does not load the chamber.
To switch loads, right-click the gun with another compatible ammo stack. The chamber clears and old rounds return to your cursor. Put returned ammo away before clicking again. Empty-cursor right-click detaches ammo.

[size=4][b]Weapon progression[/b][/size]
Normal Guild access is required for all purchases.
SAA — .45 Colt, 6 rounds, 18,000g; no additional unlock.
Double-Barrel — 12 gauge, 2 rounds, 25,000g; no additional unlock.
Sawed-Off — 12 gauge, 2 rounds, 20,000g; Mine floor 30.
Repeater — .30 Rifle, 8 rounds, 60,000g; Mine floor 60.
Double-Action Revolver — .45 Colt, 6 rounds, 45,000g; Mine floor 90.
Pump-Action — 12 gauge, 5 rounds, 65,000g; Mine floor 120.
Bolt-Action — .30 Rifle, 5 rounds, 90,000g; Skull Key, Skull Cavern floor 25 visit and 100 Mummy kills.
C96 — 9mm, 10 rounds, 70,000g; Skull Cavern floor 50 record and 250 Serpent-family kills.
MP5 — 9mm, 20 rounds; first C96 acquisition and combat level 10, then deliver 20 Iron Bars, 10 Iridium Bars and 5 Battery Packs to Marlon. One-time reward, no gold fee.
M1 Garand — .30 Rifle, 8 rounds; first Bolt-Action acquisition, Skull Cavern floor 100, 100 Mummy kills and 250 Serpent-family kills. Claim one free from Marlon.
Normal and Royal Serpents count together. Legendary rewards include guarded manual lost-gun recovery, not unlimited shop copies.

[b]Existing saves[/b]
Take prerequisite guns out of storage once so acquisition is recorded. The Bolt-Action's cavern-floor-25 visit may need to be repeated. Back up before installing, updating or experimenting with compatibility. Safe removal of custom items is not guaranteed merely by deleting the mod folder.

[size=4][b]Credits and disclosure[/b][/size]
Direction, selections, pixel-art revisions and in-game testing: JOEWRKS. Code, art drafts, tooling and this description were developed using generative AI with owner review and revisions.
Audio is processed from CC0 recordings, with additional synthesis/remixing; it is not a claim of authentic recordings for every depicted gun. Sources: Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras and Matthew Nanney (Free Firearm Sound Library); JumboSizedFish; Brian MacIntosh/BMacZero; Guy_Personface; Iochi Glaucus; Julie Damsgaard/Spring Spring; michorvath; Danwardvs; MPierluissi. CREDITS.md in the ZIP lists the source links and file derivations.
Thanks to ConcernedApe, SMAPI and Harmony. This is an unofficial mod, not endorsed by them or any firearm manufacturer.

[b]Permissions[/b]
Ask before reuploading, distributing a modified build or extracting original code/art assets. Translation-only patches may be shared without separate permission if they require and link to the original mod, credit JOEWRKS and do not bundle its DLLs or art. Third-party CC0 recordings retain their own permissions; see PERMISSIONS.md.

[b]Bug reports[/b]
Include firearm, ammunition, location, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url]. Review logs for private information before sharing. Please report other combat mods in use.

[size=4][b]한국어 안내[/b][/size]
총기 10종·탄약 16종, 조준·장전·내구도·정비가 포함된 싱글플레이 베타입니다. 한국어/영어를 지원합니다. 검증 환경은 Windows / Stardew Valley 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.3.2 / 키보드·마우스이며 멀티플레이·분할화면·컨트롤러는 지원하지 않습니다.
저장 파일을 백업하고 ZIP 안의 RedValleyRedemption 폴더를 Mods에 넣으세요. 총에 맞는 탄약을 인벤토리에서 우클릭으로 붙인 뒤 R을 한 번 눌러 장전합니다. 좌클릭 발사, 우클릭 유지 조준, MP5는 좌클릭 유지 연사입니다. 총기 오일을 가지고 정지 상태에서 Shift+G를 1.5초 유지하면 청소하고, 수리는 클린트에게 맡깁니다.
일반 총기는 길드에서 진행 조건에 따라 구매합니다. MP5와 M1은 말론의 1회 보상이며 자세한 조건은 위 목록을 참고하세요. 이미 보유한 선행 총기는 상자에서 한 번 꺼내야 획득 기록이 반영될 수 있습니다. 일부 복구·중단·저장 경계 조건은 추가 실게임 검증이 필요합니다. 문제가 있으면 총기·탄종·장소·재현 순서와 SMAPI 로그를 알려주세요.
